knowledge:
- key_parameters: filterId=The unique name/identifier assigned to the drawn gate ;; dims=A list of channel/detector names or marker names to plot and gate on ;; subset=The parent population/gate to subset the data before gating ;; regate=Logical indicating whether to overwrite an existing gate with the same filterId ;; gating_strategy=A tibble defining sequential gates to apply in batch
- alternatives: ncdfFlow (read.ncdfFlowSet)=Use when working with very large flowSets to access data directly from the hard drive and save RAM ;; flowWorkspace/flowCore=Use for automatic, data-driven gating or importing pre-gated FlowJo workspaces ;; FlowJo/Kaluza=Commercial GUI-based software for manual gating
- when_to_use: Use when you want to perform manual, GUI-based gating of flow cytometry data entirely within R to maintain reproducibility, version control, and avoid expensive commercial software.
- pitfalls: Drawing a gate before selecting the gate type in the Shiny UI can cause errors or result in an empty 0% gate ;; Exiting the Shiny window without clicking 'Done' can leave the app running in the background, blocking the R console ;; Applying polygon gates to very large, untransformed datasets can cause data points to shift during gating ;; load_gs() can fail on Windows unless the file path is wrapped in file.path() ;; Using 'color' instead of 'colour' in ggcyto will cause silent failures or errors ;; Adding a flowjo_biex scale to a ggcyto plot can make quadrant gates disappear, requiring manual geom_hline/geom_vline workarounds.

workflows.name: interactive_manual_gating
workflows.intent: Import FCS files, convert to a GatingSet, apply compensation, interactively draw manual gates (polygon, span, quadrant), and export plots and statistics.
workflows.stages: 1. Read FCS files into a flowSet ;; 2. Convert the flowSet to a GatingSet ;; 3. Read and apply compensation ;; 4. Interactively draw gates (Leukocytes, CD45, CD33/CD15) ;; 5. Visualize gates and export population statistics ;; 6. Save the GatingSet
workflows.code:
library (flowGate)
library (flowCore)
path_to_fcs <- system.file ( "extdata" , package = "flowGate" )
fs <- read.flowSet ( path = path_to_fcs, pattern = ".FCS$" , full.names = TRUE )
library (flowWorkspace)
gs <- GatingSet (fs)
path_to_comp <- system.file ( "extdata" , "compdata" , "compmatrix" , package = "flowCore" )
comp_matrix <- read.table (path_to_comp, header = TRUE , skip = 2 , check.names = FALSE )
comp <- compensation (comp_matrix)
gs <- compensate (gs, comp)
colnames (gs)
markernames (gs)
gs_gate_interactive (gs, filterId = "Leukocytes" , dims = list ( "FSC-H" , "SSC-H" ))
autoplot (gs[[ 1 ]], gate = "Leukocytes" )
gs_gate_interactive (gs, filterId = "CD45" , dims = "CD45" , subset = "Leukocytes" )
ggcyto (gs[[ 1 ]], aes ( "CD45" )) + geom_density () + geom_gate ( "CD45" ) + geom_stats ()
gs_gate_interactive (gs[[ 1 ]], filterId = "CD33 CD15" , dims = list ( "CD33" , "CD15" ), subset = "CD45" )
gs_get_pop_paths (gs)
ggcyto (gs[[ 1 ]], aes ( "CD33" , "CD15" )) + geom_hex ( bins = 128 ) + scale_x_flowjo_biexp ( maxValue = 252245 , widthBasis = -29 , pos = 4 ) + scale_y_flowjo_biexp ( maxValue = 250000 , widthBasis = -12 , pos = 5 ) + geom_gate ( c ( "CD33 APC-CD15 FITC+" , "CD33 APC+CD15 FITC+" , "CD33 APC+CD15 FITC-" , "CD33 APC-CD15 FITC-" )) + geom_hline ( yintercept = 80.2426 ) + geom_vline ( xintercept = 97.42192 ) + geom_stats ()
save_gs (gs, "GvHD GatingSet.gs" )
gs <- load_gs ( file.path ( "GvHD GatingSet.gs" ))
gs_pop_get_count_fast (gs)
gs_pop_get_stats (gs, type = "percent" )
gs_pop_get_stats (gs, type = "percent" , nodes = "CD45" )
gs_pop_get_stats (gs, type = pop.MFI)

workflows.name: gating_strategy_application
workflows.intent: Define a multi-gate gating strategy in a tibble and apply it sequentially to a GatingSet using batch interactive gating.
workflows.stages: 1. Import FCS files and create a compensated GatingSet ;; 2. Define a gating strategy tibble ;; 3. Apply the gating strategy sequentially
workflows.code:
library (flowGate)
library (flowCore)
library (flowWorkspace)
path_to_fcs <- system.file ( "extdata" , package = "flowGate" )
fs <- read.flowSet ( path = path_to_fcs, pattern = ".FCS$" , full.names = TRUE )
gs <- GatingSet (fs)
path_to_comp <- system.file ( "extdata" , "compdata" , "compmatrix" , package = "flowCore" )
comp_matrix <- read.table (path_to_comp, header = TRUE , skip = 2 , check.names = FALSE )
comp <- compensation (comp_matrix)
gs <- compensate (gs, comp)
strategy <- tibble :: tribble (
  ~ filterId, ~ dims, ~ subset, ~ bins,
  "Leukocytes" , list ( "FSC-H" , "SSC-H" ), "root" , 256 ,
  "CD45" , list ( "CD45" ), "Leukocytes" , 256 ,
  "CD33 CD15" , list ( "CD33" , "CD15" ), "CD45" , 64
)
gs_apply_gating_strategy (gs, gating_strategy = strategy)
